title: Surveys & Quizzes and Request forms are now separate
description: Forms used to be one list with a screen asking what kind you wanted. The sidebar now has Surveys & Quizzes and Request form. Request form opens a new form straight away, and what it collects lands in Requests. New form on Surveys & Quizzes opens the builder straight away too.
items: Team leaders can create surveys for their own department. Only an admin can open one to every department
A survey can have a public link, so people outside VizServe can answer without logging in. They can answer more than once
Every request form names a default PIC, and it has to be set before the form goes live. Every request starts under that person, and a team leader can change it at approval
Requests has a New form button and a Request forms button for your existing forms, and its list now shows each request's PIC
pending: Needs its database update: paste supabase/migrations/20261105090000_p17_15_surveys_and_request_forms.sql into the Supabase SQL editor. Until then team leaders cannot create surveys, and there is no public link or default PIC.
